preexisting_research_only_lineage_not_ca.original_mechanism: Earnings contain cash-flow and accrual components with different persistence. If investors extrapolate reported earnings without fully discounting the less persistent accrual part, lower-accrual firms may be less overvalued. A long-only low-accrual adaptation would test that accounting information mechanism, not market sensitivity, trend, price delay, or PE/size alone.
